headline: Executive order creates a White House commission on complementary and alternative medicine policy.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Clinton, sets up a White House Commission on Complementary and Alternative Medicine Policy. Based on the title, the commission's job is to look at government policy on health practices outside mainstream medicine. No summary was provided, so details about its members, duties, or reports are not covered here.

who_it_affects.how: They would receive input from the new commission on policy about complementary and alternative medicine.

who_it_affects.group: People who use or provide complementary and alternative medicine
who_it_affects.how: The commission's work focuses on policy that could relate to these health practices, though the title alone does not show any direct change for them.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 7, 2000; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
